name: Vora
description: Vora is a self-hosted media server for movies, TV, music, and IPTV with DVR, with cinematic clients for Android, Android TV, Fire TV, Roku, and the web. REQUIREMENTS: Vora needs a PostgreSQL database with the pgvector extension. Install the "pgvector" app from Community Applications FIRST (name its container "vora-postgres"), and put BOTH containers on the same user-defined Docker network (create one under Settings > Docker > Add network, e.g. "vora") so Vora can reach Postgres by container name. After both are running, browse to http://[SERVER-IP]:8080 and claim the server: the account you create there is the server admin. GPU (optional): for NVIDIA hardware transcoding, install the Nvidia-Driver plugin and set Extra Parameters to --runtime=nvidia. For an Intel or AMD GPU, set the Intel/AMD GPU field to /dev/dri.

variables.name: JWT Secret Key
variables.description: Long random string used to sign auth tokens. Generate once (e.g. openssl rand -base64 64) and keep it stable; changing it logs everyone out.
